metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean off-diagonal item cosine mapped to [0,1]. Higher indicates directional alignment, not definitive representation collapse or recommendation diversity. Null if fewer than two items exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean augmented positive-minus-negative logit over valid training positions; null if none were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of augmented positive-minus-negative logits; null if no valid positions were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid positions with margin below zero; null if none were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid positions with margin below 0.5; null if none were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Position totals for margins below 0.5 or zero. Category lists are empty because item category metadata is unavailable.
metric_definitions.recent_alpha: Direct unconstrained scalar, initialized to zero; may become negative.
metric_definitions.recent_valid_positions: Number of valid training positions used for branch diagnostics.
metric_definitions.recent_encoder_norm: Mean L2 norm of the masked backbone state before residual addition; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.recent_branch_norm: Mean L2 norm of the selected implemented branch before alpha scaling; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.recent_variant: Selected control: baseline, raw mean, unit mean (recent), or coherence-gated unit mean.
metric_definitions.embedding_near_zero_sample_count: Sampled nonpadding embeddings with norm at most 1e-8; excluded from item cosine alignment.
metric_definitions.recent_raw_item_norm: Mean within-window raw embedding norm, then averaged over supervised positions.
metric_definitions.recent_unit_item_norm: Mean within-window epsilon-normalized embedding norm, then averaged over supervised positions.
metric_definitions.recent_raw_mean_norm: Mean norm of the unnormalized causal-window embedding mean.
metric_definitions.recent_unit_mean_norm: Mean norm of the mean of individually epsilon-normalized embeddings; the pooled mean is not renormalized.
metric_definitions.recent_near_zero_item_count: Mean number of window embeddings with norm at most the serialized epsilon per supervised position.
metric_definitions.recent_near_zero_mean_rate: Fraction of supervised positions whose unit-mean vector has norm at most the serialized epsilon.
metric_definitions.recent_residual_backbone_ratio: Mean per-position ratio of the norm of alpha times the selected branch to the epsilon-clamped backbone norm.
metric_definitions.recent_backbone_margin_contribution: Mean signed backbone contribution to the sampled positive-minus-negative logit.
metric_definitions.recent_branch_margin_contribution: Mean signed alpha-scaled branch contribution to the sampled positive-minus-negative logit; negative alpha is retained without a positive-interest interpretation.
metric_definitions.recent_coherence_by_length: Counts and mean distinct-position-pair cosine for each causal nonpadding window length. Padding and diagonal pairs are excluded. Mean is null for singleton windows or when no windows have all embedding norms above epsilon.
metric_definitions.recent_gate_statistics: Mean and population standard deviation of the implemented coherence gate over supervised positions for the gated control; null for other controls or no observations.
metric_definitions.recent_scaled_branch_norm: Mean L2 norm of alpha times the recent branch; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.recent_absolute_branch_margin_contributi: Mean absolute alpha-scaled branch contribution to the positive-minus-negative logit using the trained tied scoring function; null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.existing_gradients_finite: Whether all currently retained parameter gradients are finite; null when no gradients are retained. Diagnosis performs no backward pass.
